tasks.short: Count spare parts in the store, update the parts spreadsheet after jobs, decide what to reorder, fill the parts request, check it, send it to purchasing, and store deliveries.

steps.what: Electronics repairer counts spare parts in the store
Electronics repairer updates the inventory spreadsheet of spare parts after each job
Electronics repairer decides which spare parts to reorder
Electronics repairer fills the parts request
Electronics repairer checks the final parts request
Electronics repairer e-mails the request to purchasing
Electronics repairer receives and stores delivered parts

tasks.design: Parts used are scanned onto the work order in the field service app ({OPS_SYSTEM}), which lowers stock, so the repairer does not update a spreadsheet after each job and counts become spot checks. A reorder list shows parts below their minimum level, and the request is built from the items the repairer picks. Once checked, it goes to purchasing in the system instead of by e-mail. Deciding what to reorder and storing parts stay with the repairer.
tasks.previous_blocker: Stock was counted by hand and kept in a spreadsheet updated after each job.
tasks.enabler_now: Field service apps lower stock from parts scanned on work orders.
tasks.still_hard: Obsolete parts for old equipment have no supplier code.
tasks.human_edge: Knowing which rare board to keep in stock for an old line.
tasks.altitude: The repairer decides on reorders instead of counting.

reach.learn: Whether requests arrive before stock runs out.

evidence.claim: FieldBuddy offers work orders that fill themselves in and asset management.
AMOS Production records work in real time and handles parts requests.
Workflow systems that record who did what can track staff and need works council consent.

assumptions: Boundary: from the stock round to parts stored; supplier choice is outside.
Input contract: parts labelled and minimum levels set; fallback is the spreadsheet.
Works council consent comes before use.
research_questions: Do jobs delayed by missing parts fall?

incremental.description: Electronics repairer scans parts onto work orders.

approvals.approved_version: The request as checked by the repairer in s5.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: many obsolete parts; high: mostly standard parts.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Find the right drawings and manuals, study blueprints and schematics to determine installation procedures, and write the installation checklist.

steps.what: Electronics repairer finds the right blueprints, schematics and manuals for the equipment
Electronics repairer studies blueprints, schematics and specifications to determine installation procedures
Electronics repairer writes the installation steps as a checklist

tasks.design: Drawings, manuals and specifications are linked to the equipment type in the field service app ({OPS_SYSTEM}), so the work order opens with them instead of a search through files and vendor sites. Standard installation checklists per equipment type are kept in the app, and the repairer adapts them to the site. Studying drawings and deciding the procedure stay with the repairer.
tasks.previous_blocker: Documents were searched in files and vendor sites, and checklists written each time.
tasks.enabler_now: Field service apps link documents and checklists to equipment types.
tasks.still_hard: Old equipment has only paper drawings.
tasks.human_edge: Seeing that a drawing does not match what was built on site.

reach.learn: Whether installations start with the right documents.

evidence.claim: FieldBuddy offers checklists for technicians and asset management.

assumptions: Boundary: from the installation job to the checklist written; the installation itself is outside.
Input contract: documents scanned and linked; fallback is files.
Deciding the procedure stays with the repairer.
Vendors allow documents to be stored.
research_questions: Is preparation time per installation shorter?

incremental.description: Electronics repairer links new documents to equipment types.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: one-off equipment; high: repeated equipment types.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Read the work order and fault history, talk with equipment operators, examine the equipment to judge mechanical or human error, and note the cause on the work order.

steps.what: Electronics repairer examines work orders and looks up the equipment's fault history
Electronics repairer converses with equipment operators to detect equipment problems
Electronics repairer examines the equipment to ascertain mechanical or human errors
Electronics repairer notes the cause on the paper work order

tasks.design: The work order in the field service app ({OPS_SYSTEM}) opens with the equipment's fault and repair history, so the repairer does not search old paper work orders. Fault and cause are recorded from pick lists with a short note; human error is recorded against the task, not the person. Talking with operators and examining the equipment stay with the repairer.
tasks.previous_blocker: Fault history sat in old paper work orders.
tasks.enabler_now: Field service apps keep fault history per asset with pick lists.
tasks.still_hard: History before the app is on paper.
tasks.human_edge: Getting an operator to say what really happened without blame.

evidence.claim: FieldBuddy offers asset management and work orders that fill themselves in.
Systems that record who caused errors can track staff and need works council consent.

assumptions: Boundary: from the work order to the cause recorded; the repair is outside.
Input contract: history in the app; fallback is paper files.
Talking with operators does not change.
research_questions: Do repeat faults fall when history is visible?

incremental.description: Electronics repairer keeps fault and cause lists current.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: new equipment with little history; high: older equipment with many faults.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Agree the work plan with other trades on site, arrange timing and access by phone, hand over to the next trade, and write handover notes.

steps.what: Electronics repairer coordinates efforts with other workers on site
Electronics repairer phones colleagues and planners to arrange timing and access
Electronics repairer hands over finished components to the next trade on site
Electronics repairer writes handover notes on paper

tasks.design: A shared planning board in the field service app ({OPS_SYSTEM}) shows each trade's job status, planned times and site access, so most timing questions are answered there instead of by phone. Handover notes are written on the job in the app and visible to the next trade. Agreeing plans and handing over on site stay with the repairer.
tasks.previous_blocker: Timing was arranged by phone and handovers written on paper.
tasks.enabler_now: Field service apps show job status to all trades.
tasks.still_hard: Subcontractors outside the app still need calls.
tasks.human_edge: Sorting out who goes first when two trades need the same space.

reach.learn: Whether they see job status in time.

evidence.claim: FieldBuddy offers job assignment, scheduling and work orders for technicians.
AI that allocates jobs based on behaviour or traits is high-risk; a shared status board is not.

assumptions: Boundary: from the shared job to notes written; contracts with trades are outside.
Input contract: trades use the board; fallback is phone.
Agreeing plans on site does not change.
Other trades update their status in about the time a call took.
research_questions: Do waiting times between trades fall?

incremental.description: Electronics repairer keeps own job status current.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: many subcontractors outside the app; high: in-house trades on one board.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.ambitious_version: A repairer with more time for repairs.
